citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 12:30 PM on 28-
July-2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by knocking on facility door, leaving a voice message with the
phone number on file, and texting the phone number on file. A text message was received by the inspector stating that
there was not a facility representative available for inspection. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and
records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may
result in enforcement action.
End Section
